fetch_youtube_transcript: fetch a YouTube transcript for a given video ID and return normalized text
run_youtube_quiz_fetch: run the youtube_quiz.py fetch command with a YouTube video ID argument
normalize_transcript_segments: normalize raw transcript segments into a single whitespace-cleaned text string
handle_missing_dependency: handle missing youtube-transcript-api dependency and return an error JSON message
handle_transcript_unavailable: handle unavailable transcripts and return structured error JSON with error type and message
